brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to determine the acute effects of decaffeinated coffee, caffeinated coffee and caffeine on glucose metabolism in humans
brief_title: The Acute Effects of Coffee on Glucose Metabolism

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* healthy young males
* nonsmokers
* moderate alcohol users

Exclusion Criteria:

* not on any medications that could alter glucose metabolism
* no history of blood disorders

lead_sponsor.name: Brooklyn College of the City University of New York

official_title: Human Trial of the Acute Effects of Coffee on Glucose Metabolism

sites.facility: Brooklyn College of the City University of New York
